## Verified Engineering Case Studies

### 1. NeuroLearn AI
- **Domain**: Pedagogical Curriculum Generation & Multi-LLM Router
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NVIDIA Nemotron, Gemini API, Playwright
- **Problem**: Superficial one-shot LLM summaries risk hallucinations and lack structured pedagogical reteaching loops or student privacy controls.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Architected an open-source pedagogical learning system with multi-provider inference (Nebius, NVIDIA Nemotron, Gemini, Groq), autonomous academic research coordination (Wikipedia, OpenAlex, Crossref, OpenStax), deterministic grading, and local-first guest persistence.
- **Verification**: Complete automated test suites passing across 10 canonical benchmark topics.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/neurolearn-ai
- **Live Demo**: https://neurolearn-ai-pink.vercel.app

### 2. RecoverFlow AI
- **README Overview**: "A merchant operations console for reviewing revenue recovery cases, controlling communication policy, and inspecting attributable decisions. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma/PostgreSQL, and Redis."
- **Domain**: Autonomous Revenue Recovery & Communication Policy Console
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 5, Prisma ORM, Vitest, Playwright, Tailwind CSS
- **Problem**: Failed recurring subscription payments cause massive revenue leakage, while naïve retry storms trigger bank network penalties, high transaction fees, and customer churn.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Architected an autonomous recovery platform with integer-paise financial math, L2 logistic recovery probability calibration, Thompson Sampling Multi-Armed Bandit channel dispatch, transactional outbox pattern, and SHA-256 audit chaining.
- **Verification**: 601 Vitest unit and integration tests passing across 93 suites and 82 Playwright end-to-end tests; Razorpay AI Buildathon Track 3.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/recoverflow-ai
- **Live Demo**: https://recoverflow-ai-kohl.vercel.app

### 3. ResumeScore — AI Resume Quality & ATS Match Engine
- **Domain**: Privacy-First Client-Side ATS Resume Analysis & Semantic Matching
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4, Mozilla PDF.js, Vitest, Gemini API
- **Problem**: Traditional resume evaluators require users to upload confidential resumes and personal identifiers to third-party servers, creating data privacy and leakage risks.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Engineered a local-first client architecture using Mozilla PDF.js for 100% in-browser text and layout parsing with zero server data leakage, coupled with a 7-dimension weighted scoring engine and 6-layer semantic skill matcher.
- **Verification**: 35 automated Vitest unit and integration tests passing; 100% client-side privacy architecture with zero data transmission.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/resumescore
- **Live Demo**: None (Client-only / repository release)

### 4. Credit Card Approval Prediction (CreditGuard AI)
- **Domain**: Calibrated Machine Learning Credit Risk Classification
- **Stack**: Python, Scikit-Learn, Random Forest, SHAP, Flask, Docker, GitHub Actions
- **Model**: Calibrated Random Forest (Production Champion from models/model_metrics.json)
- **Problem**: Financial institutions face severe credit default losses from asymmetric misclassification costs, where false negatives are far costlier than false positives.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Trained and benchmarked multiple classifiers; selected Calibrated Random Forest achieving 97.97% accuracy, 0.7865 ROC-AUC, 0.015387 Brier score (-14.0% error improvement vs uncalibrated), and an asymmetric 5:1 cost-weighted decision cutoff (p* = 0.0395, threshold tuned on holdout split) delivering 35.77% recall with local SHAP interpretability.
- **Verification**: 0.7865 ROC-AUC • Standard threshold: 24.39% recall, 35.29% precision • 5:1 cost-weighted threshold 0.0395: 35.77% recall, 34.11% precision (threshold tuned on holdout split).
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/Credit-Card-Approval-Prediction
- **Live Demo**: https://creditguard-ai.vercel.app

### 5. Amazon ML Challenge 2026 — Entity Resolution
- **Domain**: High-Throughput Scalable Machine Learning & Merchant Deduplication
- **Stack**: Python 3.13, LightGBM, RapidFuzz, PyArrow, NumPy, Pandas, Pytest
- **Problem**: Matching identical business entities across heterogeneous data sources with noisy names, partial addresses, and severe class imbalance at scale.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Built a scalable candidate generation inverted index and 19-feature LightGBM classification pipeline with hard-negative mining, calibrated thresholding, and streaming validation.
- **Headline Verified Result**: 0.8879 Local Holdout Macro F0.5 (0.9563 Precision) across 39 verified unit and streaming tests.
- **Repository**: Private / competition codebase (hidden from public site)
- **Live Demo**: None

### 6. FarmaLink-AI
- **Domain**: Agricultural Direct Marketplace & SaaS Prototype
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma, Supabase, Vercel
- **Problem**: Agricultural supply chains suffer from intermediary price exploitation, lack of crop disease diagnostics, and opaque transaction escrow.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Built direct farmer-to-buyer platform with AI disease diagnostic tooling and simulated escrow payment workflows.
- **Verification**: Deployed production agricultural SaaS prototype.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/farmlink-ai
- **Live Demo**: https://farmlink-umber.vercel.app
